information:
This competition can only hold a maximum of 85 competitors, so we ask that you please try to keep guests to a minimum. Be sure to register as soon as possible to guarantee a spot in the competition

The venue will not offer WiFi for the competition. 

Parker Core Knowledge students get free registration. See the registration requirements below for more information.
